name: Quick Pill 5.4.0
changelog: Apple Dynamic Island Battery Hub: Redesigned with Apple HIG design, 60 FPS right-to-left fluid liquid wave canvas physics engine, buoyant micro-bubbles, and real-time battery duration forecasting.
Seamless Boundary Transitions: Replaced previous buggy animations with clean, minimal transition effects strictly bounded within the app boundary.
Persistent Always-On-Top: Upgraded to screen-saver level priority with proactive event re-assertion to guarantee the pill stays on top across all workflows.
Lock-Screen & Background Timers: Timers use wall-clock timestamp synchronization and background throttling is disabled, keeping countdowns running seamlessly across Windows lock or sleep.
Silent Background Auto-Updater: When a new release is detected, the app automatically downloads and silently installs the update via NSIS in the background, with user preferences in Settings.
